notes: Building M2, קומה א' (±0.00 = 247.70). One apartment (1) + common lobby, stair, lift, storerooms 101-106 and refuse room.

Frames: fpE content is rotated ~-0.45 deg against tools/reg.json (E's walls, M2's walls and the site agent agree), so walls were measured in FN=(0,0,-0.45), FR=(-12,0,31.9) (M2R drawn at 31.9 on fpE) and FS=(-7.945,18.48,-13.4). Coordinates are in the fpE sheet registration, consistent with the overlays on fpE.

REGISTRATION MISMATCH WITH THE UPPER FLOORS: the M2 core/ממ"ד/stair walls on fpE sit about 0.75 m further +z (south) than on fpD and fpC (which agree with each other), with a ~0.5 deg rotation. Best rigid fit fpE -> fpD over 10 core/ממ"ד/stair walls: rotate +0.504 deg about the global origin, then translate (+0.041, -0.695) (residuals <= 0.04 m on the core; 0.03-0.15 m on north-wing walls that may differ between floors). Building E's walls agree on fpE/fpD/fpC within ~3 cm, so M2 is drawn ~0.7 m further south relative to E on the ground-floor sheet than on the 4 upper sheets. M1_aligned.json = this file with that transform applied to EVERYTHING (use it to stack M2's floors); in it the site-bound edges (north garden fence/plot-line wall at z~-4.2, the W fence x~-15.2, the M2/E fence x~-0.16, the path end at the plot line) moved by up to 0.75 m too and may need re-clipping.

Storerooms 101-106, their corridor and the refuse room are on a slab at +0.45 (section ב-ב: "+0.45=248.15" in the refuse room and the rooms N of it up to the stair-hall wall); the plan shows no steps between the lobby (±0.00) and the storeroom corridor. Refuse room is written 248.20 on the plan.

The two hatched rings (SW and E of the storerooms) enclose earth fill written "מילוי"; their tops are the gardens of the +3.00 apartment (250.60-250.68 on fpD / west elevation "+2.90=250.60"), so they are modelled as low retaining walls h=2.90 and as outdoor "garden" polygons at +2.90 (kind garden, name מילוי). Free sides draw 0.66-0.73 thick (hatch + outer double line, probably stone cladding); bands drawn against the building walls 0.42-0.48. Outside ground: 247.75-248.00 W, 248.30-248.50 S, 247.80 E.

Room names not written on this sheet: living (NW room), kitchen, en-suite, bath, hall; names are descriptive. The NW-room/dining split follows the closet S wall line (the "500" chain). Areas are at wall centrelines.
A thick line along the inside of the bedroom-3 W wall (FR u~9.95, v -0.9..0.6) is probably a wardrobe front; not modelled.

Not modelled (site agent): north boundary stone wall along the plot line (top 247.80), W garden fence (x~-15.22, 0.2 thick double line) and the M2/E separation fence/wall at x~-0.16 (retains M2's gardens ~1.2 m above E's yard); the gardens stop at them.

Retaining-wall heights are given to the fill top (+2.90 above ±0.00); their footing is at the outside ground, not at ±0.00. On fpD the fill top varies 250.00-250.90 (+2.30..+3.20), so the wall tops may step.

Stair: U-stair 2 x 9 treads 29/16.67 ("9X29\16.67=261", landing 110, width 220); which half is the first (up) flight is not certain (treads drawn in the N half, a break/zigzag line in the S half); modelled: N half up eastwards to the +1.50 landing, S half back west to +3.00 (section ג-ג: landings +1.50/+4.50/+7.50).

North garden polygon = 75.8 m2 between the W fence, the north boundary wall, the M2/E fence, the building and the entrance path, against the label "גינה פרטית 66 מ"ר"; the label probably excludes the strip W of the kitchen and/or the planting along the boundary wall. East garden 24.3 m2 vs label 23.

Area check apt 1: rooms at centrelines 108.6 m2; rooms + full exterior/ממ"ד walls (raster) 113.5, minus half of the walls shared with the stair/lobby (~0.7) = ~112.8 vs table 112.74 (incl. ממ"ד 7.5; main 105.24). Common: lobby 16.0 + stair 8.4 + its 2 cabinets 0.8 = 25.3 (table lobbies 25.81); storerooms 49.8 + corridor 10.3 (+walls) vs storage 62.79; refuse room 13.1 (outer ~14.8 = technical 14.79).

CHECKER (independent overlay2/scan check on fpE) fixed: (1) ממ"ד E wall: written "30", drawn 0.33 (faces FR u 12.965/13.295), was 0.25 with the inner face 7 cm too far E -> centre 13.13, t 0.33 (ממ"ד polygon, window and east-garden edge follow); (2) storeroom-block E wall: 0.34 thick from the stair hall down to FR v 11.68 (mid-103, not at the 101|103 wall), 0.25 thick below; the S part was a slanted segment ending 0.11 m E of the drawn wall at the refuse-room corner -> now straight at FR u 13.185 ending on the refuse-room N wall (storerooms 103/106 polygons follow); (3) refuse-room walls are drawn as two thin lines 0.24 (W, E) / 0.22 (S) apart; (4) kitchen S wall drawn 0.20 (faces FR v 4.875/5.07), was 0.16; (5) the ממ"ד-window note claimed a +1.00 sill from the section, which is printed only for E; value kept at 1.15 like M2/M3/M4. Verified without change: all other walls within ~5 cm, all 29 openings against their drawn gaps and labels, room names/kinds, stair (N flight up first, as on M2/M3), lift, fill rings, gardens.

CHECKER: the two "מילוי" outdoor polygons (fill tops at +2.90) overlap the +3.00 floor's gardens/patio in M2.json ("גינה פרטית 35 מ"ר", "גינה פרטית 26 מ"ר", "פטיו"): when assembling, use M2.json for the walkable surface and these only as the fill mass inside the low walls (and note M1.json and M2.json are 0.7 m apart unless M1_aligned.json is used).

CHECKER: SITE.json (site agent) is in the same fpE registration as this file and copies its path, steps and fill-ring walls; keep M1.json in fpE registration and use M1_aligned.json only to stack M2's floors.

FINAL CHECK (independent overlays at 90-200 px/m over every part, scans of the long walls, raster comparison of the green/blue wall fill with the wall list: every coloured wall pixel of M2 is covered except E's half of the party wall at x>0). Fixed: (1) 105 E wall continued from the corridor wall (FR v 13.03) down to the 104|105 wall (v 13.55); it was missing, leaving the entry nook of 104 open to 105; (2) refuse-room door is a double door (leaves ~95+45), jambs 1.44 apart -> w 1.40 (was 1.35); (3) stair-hall window sill 2.65 per section ג-ג (above the +1.50 half-landing; was 1.00 under the landing slab). M2.json's matching window (sill 1.15) is probably also ~2.65 above its floor; (4) the stair polygon is notched around the two cabinets (they overlapped it); (5) a degenerate 1.5 cm edge removed from the east-garden polygon.

FINAL CHECK doubts: the cabinets at the stair-hall E end lie under the +1.50 half-landing (headroom ~1.3 m) if they stand on the ground floor; section ג-ג shows vertical lines above that landing, so they may be on the landing instead. Room edges deliberately not on walls: living/dining/kitchen/hall (open plan), lobby/stair (first riser), lobby/storeroom corridor (open, no door or steps drawn although the corridor is at +0.45), the AC box (equipment symbol in the garden) and the cabinet fronts.
